The label lemma-krasner occurs exactly once in the project's canonical tag list of this snapshot, as tag 09EI, and the only referring site inside the chapter is source line 33841 in the neighbouring lemma on approximately separable extensions, which is not counted by any card.

The nearest same-chapter neighbours are the four elimination-of-ramification items public 421 (tag 0BRM, Abhyankar's lemma for tame extensions of discrete valuation rings), public 422 (tag 0EXX, tame ramification preserved under normal closure and compositum), public 423 (tag 09II, elimination of ramification for essentially finite-type valuation-ring extensions) and public 425 (tag 0ASI, descent of roots up to units through codimension-one unramified maps). All four are statements about how ramification behaves under base change or normal closure; none of them asserts that a simple root of a polynomial is stable under perturbation of the coefficients, which is a statement about the maximal-adic topology of A rather than about ramification of extensions.

Public 426 (tag 0ASJ, etale local extensions of valuation rings are weakly unramified) and public 335 (tag 09ZL, finite etale algebras over a henselian pair) are the other same-chapter neighbours in the valuation-ring and henselian-pair direction; they classify or compare extensions of rings, whereas this lemma produces an element of A by a convergent series and therefore shares neither the objects nor the conclusion.
